A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Watch & Learn and contain the main paper and Appendices A-F. Text, equations, tables, and images support reliable comparison. The prompt example clipped on v3 page 27 remains recoverable from embedded PDF text.

before.justification: v2 reports original OSWorld-Verified and WindowsAgentArena evaluations, action-labeling measurements, ablations, and appendix analyses of data scaling and application domains.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds a Claude 4 Sonnet comparison using TongUI-labeled exemplars in Table 2.

M1.justification: The six-primitive IDM, architecture, losses, retrieval procedure, and ICL/SFT pipeline are retained. New Appendix C.6 documents how existing primitives compose into executable commands; it does not establish a change to the underlying method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same approximately 600K web transitions, 53,125 video-derived trajectories across 69 applications, and OSWorld-Verified and WindowsAgentArena evaluations. The added comparison introduces no new dataset, domain, or task scenario.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds TongUI-labeled video exemplars as a comparator for Claude 4 Sonnet. v2 includes only the base and W&L conditions for Claude, although TongUI already participates in comparisons for other models.

E3.justification: The 50-step OSWorld-Verified and 15-step WindowsAgentArena limits, 100 held-out transitions per action type, metrics, and documented training settings remain unchanged. The added Claude/TongUI result uses the existing Table 2 evaluation setting.

E4.justification: The labeling analysis, exemplar-component ablation, retrieval ablation, data-scaling study, application-domain analysis, and qualitative trajectory examples are retained unchanged, including Tables 4-6 and 8-27.

E5.justification: Both versions report benchmark point estimates without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added result follows the same reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 2 newly reports 43.4% success for Claude 4 Sonnet with TongUI exemplars, 0.5 percentage points below its 43.9% base result. Claude with W&L remains at 45.5%; the other matched main-text and appendix results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical architecture and loss definitions in Appendices D-E, including Equations 1-8, are unchanged. Appendix C.6 adds implementation rationale without a new formal derivation, theorem, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about inverse-dynamics labeling, 53K trajectories, benefits for ICL and SFT, and leading 7B-scale WindowsAgentArena performance under the 15-step limit.

C2.justification: Appendix C.6 newly explains that visually indistinguishable interactions are resolved to minimal primitive sequences and argues that alignment with executable actions avoids redundant or non-executable representations. Existing result interpretations and Appendix A limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project-page link and Appendix C.6 documenting deterministic PyAutoGUI composition, click/drag mappings, and handling of ambiguous visual transitions. These expand implementation disclosure; existing hyperparameters, hardware, and data-collection details are retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to prior research are unchanged. Differences in several in-text citations are formatting changes; the reference-list content matches.

P1.justification: v3 adds a short explanatory subsection C.6 and makes limited edits to citation phrasing, benchmark ordering, internship attribution, and funding acknowledgments. The broader narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 2 gains one row, Figure 1 moves from page 1 to page 2, and Table 5 moves from page 11 to page 12. Figure and screenshot content is unchanged. Prompt reflow introduces footer overlap and clips the code example below v3 page 27.

improvement.justification: The added Claude/TongUI comparison modestly improves comparative completeness, while Appendix C.6 clarifies the connection between predicted primitives and executable actions. These gains in evidence and transparency outweigh the localized prompt-layout regression on page 27. The method, research scope, and existing results otherwise remain stable.
